description: A bearer credential (FEAT-9 / #744) that authenticates as a user, stored HASHED at rest — the plaintext secret is shown once at creation and never persisted. The on-disk token.json projection of the replicated `token:<uuid>` CRDT value. Mirrored by zetta::governance::Token in include/zetta/governance/token.hpp and enforced by token_value_from_json() + Node::load_tokens()/reconcile_tokens() — keep them in sync. `hash` = hex SHA-256(salt || secret), or for the bootstrap owner's operator-chosen secret the PBKDF2 form `pbkdf2-sha256$<iterations>$<hex>` (#769); the secret itself never appears here or in system.tokens.

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation stamp (millisecond precision, trailing 'Z').

expires_at.description: Optional TTL: the ISO-8601 UTC instant at/after which the token stops validating. Omitted means it never expires.

hash.description: The at-rest hash of the secret: hex SHA-256(salt || secret) for a generated secret, or `pbkdf2-sha256$<iterations>$<hex>` (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 over the salt) for the bootstrap owner's operator-chosen secret (#769). The plaintext is never stored.

id.description: The token's UUID — its CRDT key and on-disk folder name. Present in token.json and omitted from the CRDT value (the key carries it).

revoked.description: When true the token never validates (revocation without deletion, preserving history).

salt.description: Hex per-token salt mixed into the hash so identical secrets hash differently.

type.description: How the token was issued: a pre-assigned long-lived 'access' credential, or an issued revocable 'api' token.

user.description: The id of the User this token authenticates as.

title: Token
